title: Uruguayan Beef Skewers with Warmly Spiced Glaze
description: A fusion of Uruguayan and Chinese flavors in this sweet and savory skewer recipe. Perfect for a quick and delicious dinner.
instructions: 2. In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, olive oil, brown sugar, ginger, garlic, and five-spice powder to make the marinade.
3. Place the beef pieces in a large bowl and pour the marinade over them. Toss to coat.
4. Thread the beef pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
5. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the beef reaches an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
6. Meanwhile, prepare the spiced glaze by whisking together the warmed glaze ingredients in a small bowl.
7. During the last minute of grilling, brush the spiced glaze over the beef skewers.
8. Garnish with chopped green onions and serve immediately.
